name: nlp-lineage
description: NLP Lineage: a public reference on how NLP led to modern language models. The reference site is built with Astro; the guided tour is built with Python (build.py). The tour loads GSAP from cdnjs; the local copy only lets the tests run offline.

scripts.site:build: node scripts/prepare-tour.mjs && astro build && pagefind --site build
